xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4565: pan handoff --fresh: start a clean conversation with no summary and no parent link

plan.title: pan handoff --fresh: start a clean conversation with no summary and no parent link
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan handoff always stamps parent_conversation_id on the successor (handleConversationSummaryFork passes parentName: conv.name unconditionally) and always seeds it from the source transcript via an authored handoff document or a summary. There is no CLI way to start a clean conversation that takes only the source's defaults, e.g. starting a Dwarf Fortress fort on a cheaper model from a Project Zomboid research conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Add a boolean 'fresh' to the handoff fork request (like PAN-4499's hold). The route skips the transcript and git gates, creates the successor without a parent link, titles it from the focus, does not inherit the source issue, and refuses lane sources; runForkPipeline gets a fresh branch before any transcript read that launches the session and delivers the focus verbatim (or holds it, or delivers nothing). Recovery forwards fresh. CLI: pan handoff --fresh. Dashboard: a 'Fresh start' checkbox in the Continue dialog and a --fresh composer token. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-4565.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No pan fork --fresh and no standalone pan conv new verb
- No change to summary, plain or regular handoff behavior, output or titles
- No change to --skill/--pack inheritance of the source skill map or to conversationLaunchContext inheritance
- No AI title generation for fresh successors
- No new forkMode value and no new forkStatus value
- No schema migration: fresh lives only inside the existing fork_request JSON
- No callerKind-based exception to the lane guard
- No allowlist cap raise for conversation-forks.ts

autoDecisions.summary: Model --fresh as a boolean 'fresh' on the handoff request (like PAN-4499's hold), not a fourth forkMode
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the three forkMode unions, parsePersistedForkRequest and the frontend ApiForkMode unchanged; hold is the established precedent for a handoff modifier.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard control is a 'Fresh start' checkbox under the Agent handoff intent, beside Hold
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a toggle in the handoff dialog; a checkbox matches the existing Hold control and sends the same request as the CLI.

autoDecisions.summary: Fresh skips the source session-file gates (route, pipeline, CLI) and the git-worktree gate
autoDecisions.rationale: The source is only a defaults donor and its transcript is never read; the git gate exists for document authoring, and a plain new conversation has no such gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Fresh with no focus and no hold launches the successor and delivers nothing; fresh+hold with no focus is a 400
autoDecisions.rationale: A conversation with no first message is a valid new conversation; holding an empty kickoff would make the kickoff door send an empty message.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse fresh when the source's effective launcher is a gauntlet lane, for every caller
autoDecisions.rationale: A fresh successor is a root and could launch root-only lanes, escaping PAN-4223 D21; callerKind cannot gate it because every conv-* session, lanes included, is classified operator.

autoDecisions.summary: A fresh successor does not inherit the source's issueId (uses --issue, else the cwd's branch issue)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists only project, cwd, model and effort as inherited defaults; an issue link is a soft lineage the operator asked to drop.

autoDecisions.summary: Fresh title: --title, else the focus cut to 70 chars without a 'Handoff:' prefix, else 'New conversation'
autoDecisions.rationale: The source title is exactly the context being discarded (the Zomboid example); the successor is a root, not a handoff.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract source-session helpers out of conversation-forks.ts before adding fresh logic
autoDecisions.rationale: The file is 973 lines against a 1000-line ceiling with no allowlist row, and agents may not raise caps.

autoDecisions.summary: CLI exits 1 on --fresh with --author source or --author-model
autoDecisions.rationale: Those flags configure an authoring session that a fresh start never runs; an explicit conflict is clearer than silently ignoring it. --author's commander default 'external' cannot be detected, so only explicit source/model are refused.

autoDecisions.summary: Add ForkModal.test.tsx and handoffComposerArgs.test.ts to test:frontend-subset
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend tests; without this the dialog AC test never runs in CI.

metadata.sizeJustification: One CLI flag whose wire contract must land on the server route and pipeline, the CLI, the dashboard dialog and the docs in one PR: shipped separately, the CLI flag or the dialog checkbox would silently perform a full handoff (summary + parent link) against a server that ignores fresh.
